question: Where is the nearest fast food restaurant encountered en route to Hilton Garden Inn Chicago Downtown South Loop, Chicago, IL from In the Game - Hollywood Park, Crestwood, IL?
sql: WITH start_point AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%In the Game - Hollywood Park%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Crestwood%' LIMIT 1 ), end_point AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Hilton Garden Inn Chicago Downtown South Loop%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Chicago%' LIMIT 1 ), route_line AS ( SELECT ST_MakeLine(s.geometry, e.geometry) AS geom FROM start_point s, end_point e ), buffered_route AS ( SELECT ST_Buffer(geom::geography, 500) AS geom -- 500 meters buffer around the route FROM route_line ) SELECT p.poi_name, p.addr_state, p.addr_city FROM pois p WHERE p.amenity = 'fast_food' AND ST_Intersects(p.geometry::geography, (SELECT geom FROM buffered_route)) ORDER BY ST_Distance(p.geometry::geography, (SELECT geometry FROM start_point)::geography) LIMIT 1;
